title: An OAuth app
description: An OAuth app people sign in with: who holds it, where it came from, and the service's app. Never its client secret.

issuer.description: The authorization server's issuer URL, whose metadata names its endpoints.

resource.description: The API or MCP server its tokens are for. Finds the issuer where none is given.

authorization_endpoint.description: Where a person signs in, for a service without metadata. Given with token_endpoint.

token_endpoint.description: Where a code is exchanged for a token. Given with authorization_endpoint.

client_id.description: The OAuth app's client ID. Without one, Wardrik becomes the client where the service allows.

client_secret.description: The vault secret holding the app's client secret. Omitted for an app without one, or one given its secret in config.

name.description: The secret's name in the owner's vault.

client_auth.description: How the client secret is sent: in the form, or as HTTP Basic.

flow.description: How a person signs in: in a browser, or with a code on another device.

authorization_params.description: Extra parameters for a browser sign-in, as access_type: offline. Can't set the ones Wardrik sends itself.
